scope: Offline signed-feed and guarded A/B update implementation. No printer access or write; separate disposable QEMU boot journey is still pending.

signed-feed.method: Eleven focused tests used a local HTTPS server, disposable CMS signer and injected disposable bundle verifier. Covered exact CMS signed bytes, schema/profile/expiry, replay and same-sequence metadata equivocation, redirects, truncation, and signed-index retry.
signed-feed.limitations: Bundle verification is the test double; no RAUC bundle was installed. No production release signer, feed endpoint or trust-anchor package exists yet.

automatic-admission.method: Feed tests exercised opt-out before network and after download, customized/writable source, pending transaction, policy rechecks, and stage/arm ordering. Existing Transaction and RAUC backend tests were rerun in the same focused suite.
automatic-admission.limitations: Feed tests use a transaction test double. Existing RAUC backend tests are independent fixtures and do not show a feed-driven slot write.

crash-replay.method: Tests exercised staged retry, uncertain installing/arming journals, killed-download partial cleanup, unjournaled published-bundle cleanup, persistent sequence damage/missing state, clock rollback, and repeated polls. Cleanup is limited to private, managed filenames under state/staging locks.
crash-replay.limitations: Injected interruption tests do not remove power from an ARM64 guest or physical device.

integration-boundaries.method: A static capacity regression test reads the tracked 8 GB layout and 1 GiB maximum bundle policy. The data partition is 2447 MiB; bundle plus 768 MiB required free reserve is 1792 MiB, leaving at most 655 MiB of preexisting use while the gate passes. Staging and transaction checks enforce free-space and copy reserves dynamically. Unit tests verified fixed timer/service installation, no feed config by default, UI status integration, automatic opt-out state, and host-only staging.
integration-boundaries.limitations: This establishes nominal partition arithmetic and fail-closed thresholds, not free-space headroom in a composed release or printer. The ARM64 QEMU journey and installed service/timer run are separate pending work; the current image baseline is explicitly non-bootable. No recovery or physical acceptance is claimed.

validation.command: PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest tests.test_sv08_feed tests.test_stage_admin_ui tests.test_staging tests.test_transaction tests.test_staged_transaction tests.test_rauc_backend tests.test_rauc_service tests.test_admin tests.test_admin_images tests.test_admin_jobs tests.test_admin_resolution tests.test_admin_upload tests.test_package_rauc
